newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Former WA Premier Brian Burke sentenced to three years.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Former WA Premier Brian Burke sentenced to three years.

text.p: Former Western Australia state premier Brian Burke was sentenced to three years in jail on Friday for stealing more than A$120,000 in political donations to amass a personal stamp collection.
Burke, 50, Australia's ambassador to Ireland and the Holy See from 1988 to 1991, was found guilty of stealing from his Australian Labor Party while premier in 1984 and 1985.

Burke told the Western Australian District Court the money had been donated to a "leader's account" and was his to use as he chose. He admitted spending A$87,000 on stamps, but said they were an investment for the Labor party.
Western Australia premier from 1983 to 1988, Burke spent seven months in jail in 1994 for stealing A$17,000 from his parliamentary travel expenses.
